lines.text: A big change for the better.
Wow, your glow-up this year is amazing.

data.mean: A big change for the better.
data.define: A big improvement in how someone looks, feels or lives.

example.text: Wow, your glow-up this year is amazing.

misuse.text: Don't tell someone their glow-up means they looked bad.
misuse.why: It implies they looked bad before.

publish.title: What does "glow-up" mean?
